summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for Looma extension scope. Backend regression + new extension tests passed (80/80). UI flows verified for upload modal controls/progress/redirect, Studio brand placement, CTA form overlay + lead capture, security private-link enforcement, analytics CSV action, and Remix aspect ratio render actions.

integration_issues.flow: Browser playback for external seeded media URLs
integration_issues.issue: CORS errors appear for externally hosted example.com video assets; player shell and other app flows still work, but media stream cannot load in-browser.

action_items: No backend fixes required from this run.
For stable browser demos, use storage-backed uploaded videos instead of external example.com assets to avoid CORS playback failures.
If lint verification is required as a gate, add a frontend lint script (package.json currently has no lint command).
critical_code_review_comments: Domain restriction logic currently allows requests when Origin/Referer headers are absent; this is browser-compatible but not strict for non-browser callers.
Studio Share embed code includes JSON-LD schema + iframe in code construction path (verified by source review), and copy actions are wired.
Public viewer chapter rendering depends on successful public video fetch/unlock state; password-protected videos correctly gate player and chapters until unlocked.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (requested critical flows passed; external CORS playback limitation observed)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_iter6 users/videos/CTAs/leads via API tests and one UI-uploaded video (iter6-ui).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary evidence: pytest_iter6_full.xml and pytest_iter6_extension.xml. UI automation logs/screenshots under /app/test_reports/pytest and /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260531_035750, /20260531_035903, /20260531_040258. QA credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used for UI login.
rca of the issue: Observed browser playback failures are caused by external media host CORS policy (example.com demo URLs), not Looma API/player logic. Domain restriction check behaves as intended for disallowed Origin/Referer, and private token enforcement/rotation works end-to-end.
